_walletConnect: Reown (ex-WalletConnect Cloud) projectId. PUBLIC by design: it ships in every dApp bundle and grants no access to funds or signatures — it only attributes relay traffic. Lock it down with the Allowed Domains list in dashboard.reown.com, not by hiding it. Empty string = WalletConnect disabled, injected wallets only.
